statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has a history of documented supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm and assess for recurrent paroxysmal tachyarrhythmias
The denial was based on missing prior authorization
The diagnosis codes submitted were R55 and I47.1
